speaker.name: Christian Carballo Lozano
speaker.title: Data Scientist at Plain Concepts
speaker.bio: Christian Carballo Lozano is a Mathematician working as a Data Scientist at Plain Concepts. He has been working in diverse environments, such as in Research, R&D, and Software Engineering, all of them pivoting around Machine Learning, Algorithms, and Optimization. As a Data Scientist, he deploys end-to-end cloud-based AI solutions. As a Mathematician, he enjoys deepening in the algorithms for understanding and developing them.
